name: Heat Hawk
description: Melee weapon with reach 2 inches and Hit 4+.

counterattacks.name: Heat Hawk Counter
counterattacks.trigger: After an enemy declares a ranged attack from a normal order and chooses its target, before attack dice or interception rolls. The shooter must be within 2 inches and in torso-to-torso line of sight. The target can be the equipped suit or another legal target.
counterattacks.effect: Attack the triggering shooter. Resolve the counterattack's heat check and consequences. A defeated shooter loses its remaining normal order; a surviving shooter resumes if still legal.
